What should be the primary way people understand, select, and improve tool use?

ActionCan a persona select the right capability for the current work?

OPTION B / MATCHING

Capability-first picker

Most portable

OPTION E / RECOMMENDED SYNTHESIS

Layered hybrid

Most complete

Keep each model in the place where it is strongest: reference in the library, matching in the capability picker, action in toolkits, and dependencies in an advanced map.

One system, four entry points

1 · Tool libraryCanonical records for tools, scopes, limits, lessons, and versions.
2 · Capability pickerSkills request portable capabilities; the system resolves compatible tools.
3 · Workflow toolkitsPlaybooks coordinate personas, tools, workspaces, outputs, and approvals.
4 · Relationship mapAdvanced view for coverage, dependencies, and shared learning.
  • Best when the system needs browsing, action, portability, and architecture without forcing one view to do everything.
  • Tradeoff: requires clear boundaries so the same guidance does not get copied into every layer.
